verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents installable plugins that connect it to third-party tools such as Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, and Gong, and it also supports adding third-party MCP servers. This covers the 'add third-party connectors' half of the story. The evidence never shows a browsable directory or marketplace for finding apps, and there is no hands-on corroboration of the install flow. Missing for 10: a documented browsable app/connector directory, details of the discovery and install flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: Install the Slack plugin to summarize channels or draft replies.
Plugins can connect ChatGPT to the tools and information you use for work, such as Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, or Gong.
Install the Codex Security plugin to scan authorized code and confirm plausible vulnerability findings.
Allow GPT builders to use approved workspace apps or configure actions that interact with permitted third-party APIs.
